rubrics.justification: The morphology description is plausible and internally consistent for an expanded/hatching blastocyst with roughly BB quality, but it includes confidence about features like early herniation and detailed sectoral TE grading that may be difficult to verify from a single image.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle history well with embryo quality and prognosis, though some links are somewhat overstated.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with prognosis flowing from embryo quality and patient factors, though some numerical adjustments and emphasis on alcohol/stress are more speculative than firmly supported.

Core recommendations like single embryo transfer and avoiding routine PGT-A at age 28 are guideline-concordant, but suggestions such as ERA, NK cell testing, thrombophilia screening, growth hormone, and broad additional workup after a single failed transfer are not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management and future planning, but several proposed investigations/interventions are more aggressive than typically warranted after a first cycle.
